_doc: Policy for kill_guard.py (GoodQA #14506, redesign 2026-11-24). mode: enforce | warn | off. protected and staging_live are regexes searched in a process command line, launchd label, systemd unit, tmux session, pm2 app or container name; stopping a match needs the owner's approval (a harness maintainer may stop `protected` ones). Host and unit names belong here, never in the code.
